_comment: Single source of truth for the classes CropGuard's model is allowed to predict. ml_training/train_kaggle.py maps raw dataset folder names onto these labels; the backend advisory knowledge base (backend/model/advisory_db.json) must provide one advisory entry per label listed here. Do not add a label unless training data for it exists and an advisory entry has been written.
label_format: Crop___Condition, where Condition uses PlantVillage spelling (underscores, no spaces)
